headline: Approved consent agenda, liquor permit expansion, and liquor license for The Boardroom
summary: The commission adopted the consent agenda, which included a one-day outside consumption permit expansion for Citizen Cider's CiderFest. It also approved a First Class Liquor License application for The Boardroom at 3 Mill Street, contingent on Fire Marshal approval and standard conditions.
decisions: Adopted the consent agenda and took the actions indicated, including the Citizen Cider outside consumption permit expansion for CiderFest, October 3, 2026.
Approved the 2026-2027 First Class Liquor License Application for The Boardroom, 3 Mill Street, contingent upon Fire Marshal approval and with all standard conditions.

decision_evidence.quote: Motion made by Commissioner Broderick, seconded by Commissioner Singh, to adopt the consent agenda and take the actions indicated. Motion passed unanimously.
